title: Clyx Order
tagline: Commission-free restaurant ordering platform used by restaurant owners across Saudi Arabia.
overview: Clyx Order is a restaurant ordering platform built as an alternative to commission-heavy delivery marketplaces. Restaurants get their own branded ordering app and dashboard without paying a cut on every order.
problem: Restaurant owners in Saudi Arabia were losing 15-30% of every order to third-party delivery marketplace commissions, with no ownership over their customer data or branding.
solution: I helped build a white-label ordering system: a Flutter customer app, a Laravel API handling menus/orders/payments, and a Next.js admin dashboard restaurant owners use to manage their storefront — all without any per-order commission.
architecture: Flutter app with BLoC for state management talks to a Laravel API secured with Sanctum. Orders, menu items, and branch data are modeled per-tenant so a single backend serves multiple restaurant brands (including Pureger). The Next.js dashboard consumes the same API for real-time order management.
features: Branch selection with live menu and pricing per location
Cart and checkout flow with multiple payment methods
Order tracking from placement to delivery
Multi-tenant architecture so new restaurant brands onboard without new infrastructure
Owner dashboard for menu management, order history, and basic sales reporting
challenges: Designing a data model that cleanly supports multiple restaurant brands on shared infrastructure without leaking data between tenants
Keeping menu and price updates from the dashboard reflected instantly in the customer app
Handling order state transitions reliably across app, API, and dashboard simultaneously
lessonsLearned: Multi-tenancy decisions made early (even before a second tenant exists) save weeks of migration work later
Real-time order status is worth the extra plumbing — it's the single feature restaurant owners notice first
futureImprovements: Native push notifications for order status changes
Analytics dashboard with per-branch performance comparisons
Driver-facing app for in-house delivery fleets
results: Live in production serving real restaurant brands, including Pureger
Zero per-order commission model, compared to 15-30% on typical delivery marketplaces
